sections.text_helper: Section 6.8.3 "Strobe error (STRBERR)" in chapter 6 (Embedded flash memory (FLASH)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 168.
sections.section_content:
When the application software writes several times to the same byte in the write buffer, the
FLASH sets the strobe error flag STRBERR in FLASH_SR, whatever the target bank of the
write access.
When STRBERR is raised, the current program operation is aborted and the write buffer is
invalidated.
STRBERR is cleared by setting CLR_STRBERR bit to 1 in FLASH_CCR.
If STRBERRIE bit in FLASH_CR is set to 1, an interrupt is generated when STRBERR flag
is raised (see Section6.9 for details).
